re_audit.note: One hunk: dotenv.config() now runs only when VITEST is unset (SAFE-02 src layer, D-01). Setup-layer block is independent. Under a real start with VITEST set, src/main.ts refuses first (see AUD-BUY-034). No config parsing changed.

Hunks reviewed: imports, repo-root anchored path resolution, src-layer tripwire under Vitest (RC-19), openGuardedDb in place of new Database (RC-25), verbatim migrateSchema removal plus migrateSchema(db) at the original point (D-24, re-verified byte-identical on HEAD in judgment-reviews.json), and a getDbFilePath accessor used by tests only. Relative DB_PATH is now anchored to the repo root rather than the cwd (planned, AC-25); the unconditional user_version write and normalizeLegacyMainnetRows at import are unchanged, so RC-25 is closed only for the newer-schema half (see AUD-DB-006). Pragmas run only after openGuardedDb returns.

Reviewed. dotenv gated on VITEST; refuseUnderVitest runs first inside both existing try blocks, so the existing catch logs it, callers never see a throw, and the dashboard broadcast still runs. Ledger global is optional-chained, so outside a railed process nothing is touched; the message never carries the token.

Reviewed in full. resolveDbPath anchors to the repo root and gives a per-worker temp file under Vitest (E10). openGuardedDb probes, refuses, then opens with fileMustExist, re-reads dev+ino and user_version through the write handle. Windows path forms normalised. The temp-copy fallback was judged in judgment-reviews.json (question b): a direct read-only open of a live WAL file when the copy failed is acceptable because -wal and -shm exist, it adds no write beyond what SQLite's reader does to -shm, and the write open follows anyway with the identity and version re-checks. A :memory: DB_PATH outside Vitest fails closed at the statSync re-check rather than running on a volatile DB, which is the safe direction. Two defects fixed in 5378478 are registered: AUD-DB-023 (probe cleanup failure) and AUD-DB-024 (linked data folder).

Moved verbatim from db.ts (D-24, operator-accepted). Body hash equals the audit-base body on HEAD; only the signature line differs, plus the CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION export (still 7). Migration idempotence and transaction wrapping unchanged from the base; the base-audited issues stay on their base findings.

Reviewed in full. Walks up to the nearest package.json named crypto-snipe-bot from the calling file; uses no git and no __dirname depth, and returns a native real path. A throw on no match fails closed.
